A ruthless '''massacre''' was committed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] against demonstrators on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> in approximately [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had ordered the arrest of Chandrila's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], although she was able to [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|escape]] capture. In response, [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] citizens organized demonstrations on their home planet, which the Empire responded to by [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of them.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'', the third novel in [[Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']] written by [[A. C. Crispin]] and published in [[1998]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn" />
